'''Strange Encounters''' is the standard board in [[Neverness to Everness]]. It is used to obtain characters and arcs. 

==Fair Details==
===Duration===
* Permanent 

==Item Pool==
{{Board Pool
|character_S_F = Baicang;Daffodill;Fadia;Hathor;Jiuyuan;Sakiri
|character_A_F = Adler;Mint;Edgar;Haniel; Aurelia; Skia
|arc_A       = The Forgotten*The Forgotten; Clear Skies (Arc)*Clear Skies; Watch Your Heads!*Watch Your Heads!; Umbrella*Umbrella; Drawn Blade*Drawn Blade
|arc_B       = First Step to Success*First Step to Success; "Real Music"*"Real Music"; Be Happy*Be Happy; Dangerous Game*Dangerous Game; Us.*Us.
}}

== Rules ==
=== Fair Guide ===
# Strange Encounters is permanently available in the Fair and offers non-limited items. 
# Consume [[Fabricated Dice]] to obtain movement points, move to the corresponding tile, and obtain items.

=== Rookie Hunter Benefits ===

# For your 1st-5th 10x Rolls, only 8 Fabricated Dice are needed. This does not apply to single rolls. 
# On your first 50 total rolls on the Strange Encounters board, get one S-Class character of your choice. Pick from six common S-Class Characters to join your team. 

=== Character and Arc Drop Rates ===

# Each roll has a 1.87% chance to obtain one of the common S-Class Characters (pity included). 
# Board starts as Baseline. If no S-Class character is obtained for 70 consecutive dice rolls, Board Modification will trigger, significantly increasing the probability of obtaining current limited S-Class character per roll. After obtaining a current limited S-Class character, the current board will revert to Baseline.
# If no S-Class character is obtained for '''89''' consecutive dice rolls, the next roll with not move the piece and will immediately grant a current limited S-Class character. At most 90 dice rolls guarantee a current limited S-Class character.

# Each roll has a 22.98% chance to obtain an A-Class Character or Arc (bonus included). 
# Every 10 rolls grants a Points Gift. The gift has a 20% chance to drop an A-Class character and an 80% chance to drop an A-Class Arc. 
# Each roll has a 65.33% chance to obain a B-Class Arc. 

=== Duplicates ===

# Obtaining the same S-Class Character for the 2nd-7th time converts each duplicate into 1 Mind Shard of that character and 40 Warp Pieces. From the 8th duplicate onward, each converts into 80 Warp Pieces. 
# Obtaining the same A-Class Character for the 2nd-7th time converts each duplicate into 1 Mind Shard of that character and 6 Warp Pieces. From the 8th duplicate onward, each converts into 12 Warp Pieces. 
# Dropping an A-Class Arc on the board grants 4 Warp Pieces. 
# Dropping a B-Class Arc on the board grants 20 Lost Pieces. 

=== Board Squares ===
Apprentice Chest: 45.93% chance per roll to open an Apprentice Chest. Has a 0.2% chance to drop an S-Class Character and 99.8% chance to drop a B-Class Arc. 

Hero Chest: 20.07% chance per roll to open a Hero Chest. Has a 3% chance to drop an S-Class Character and 97% chance for a B-Class Arc. 

Journey Together: 10.86% chancer per roll to land on this tile. Has a 1.19% chance to drop an S-Class Character and 9.67% for an A-Class Character. 

Roll Again: 1.57% chance per roll to land on this tile. Grants 1  Fabricated Die. 

Multiple Surprises: 0.38% chance per roll to land on this tile. Grants 5 Fabricated Dice. 

Warp Piece Box: 2.37% chance per roll to open a Warp Piece Box. Grants the number of Warp Pieces shown on the tile. 

Lost Piece Box: 15.47% chance per roll to open a Lost Piece Box. Grants the number of Lost Pieces shown on the tile. 

Arc-light Mystery Box: 3.31% chance per roll to open an Arc-light Mystery Box. Grants a random A-Class Arc currently shown on the board.

Slumberland: 3.15% chance per roll to trigger Slumberland. When triggered, the Guardian moves 9 tiles ahead. You must catch up within 3 dice rolls. After each roll, the Guardian moves 2 tiles forward. Catch the Guardian grants 30 Warp Pieces.
